import subprocess,re
from pathlib import Path
files=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-z']).decode().split('\\0')
p=re.compile(r'(?i)(api[_ -]?key|access[_ -]?key|secret[_ -]?key|token|password|credential|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|ASIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|gh[pousr]_|github_pat_|hf_)')
for f in files:
 if not f: continue
 try: lines=Path(f).read_text().splitlines()
 except (UnicodeError,OSError):continue
 for n,l in enumerate(lines,1):
  if p.search(l):
   # Only reveal keywords and positions, never values.
   print(f'{f}:{n}: '+', '.join(sorted(set(m.group(0) for m in p.finditer(l)))))
PY"

import subprocess,re

pat=re.compile(r'AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}|ASIA[A-Z0-9]{16}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}|hf_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}|AIza[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,}')

for f in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-z']).decode().split('\\0'):
 if not f:continue
 try:t=Path(f).read_text()
 except (OSError,UnicodeError):continue

   l=pat.sub('<REDACTED>',l)
   l=re.sub(r'(?<=[=:\\s])[\\w/+.-]{24,}', '<LONG-VALUE>',l)
   print(f'{f}:{n}: {l[:350]}')
